traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Mushroom characterized by a smooth, often sticky cap and yellowish tubes under the cap. It is particularly noted for the droplets (or "weeping") that appear at the base of the tubes, which gives the mushroom its common name. It forms a mycorrhizal relationship with pine trees, helping the trees to absorb water and nutrients while receiving sugars and other nutrients in return. While edible, it's not typically considered a top-tier culinary mushroom due to its somewhat slimy texture. Nevertheless, it can be a nice addition to dishes when cooked properly, and some recommend removing the skin of the cap to improve the texture.
